source.manualTitle: Whirlpool Jazz French Door Refrigerator (W10322959B, 19–22 cu ft)

steps.title: Disconnect power
steps.body: Unplug the refrigerator or disconnect power before servicing. Replace all parts and panels before operating.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Disconnect power before servicing. Replace all parts and panels before operating.

steps.title: Continue in Service Test Mode
steps.body: Service Test Mode (S-E) entered. Use Freezer UP/DOWN to select the test number for this procedure.
steps.sourceExcerpt: You are now in the SERVICES TEST operational mode and may use the diagnostic tests.

steps.title: Select Service Test 4
steps.body: In Service Test Mode (S-E), use Freezer UP/DOWN keys until freezer display shows 4. Refrigerator display blank until test is activated.

steps.title: Activate test 4
steps.body: Press Refrigerator UP to run FF thermistor circuit test. Freezer displays 4.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Press Refrigerator UP to run FF thermistor circuit test. Freezer displays 4.

steps.title: FF thermistor service test result
steps.body: Refrigerator display: P=Pass, O=Open, S=Short. What does the display show?
steps.sourceExcerpt: Refrigerator display: P=Pass, O=Open, S=Short. What does the display show?

steps.title: Deactivate test 4
steps.body: Deactivate test before selecting another test number.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Deactivate test before selecting another test number.

steps.title: Bench FF thermistor ohms
steps.body: Disconnect power. Measure fresh food thermistor — 10 kΩ @ 77°F; 29.5 kΩ @ 36°F; 86.3 kΩ @ 0°F.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Disconnect power. Measure fresh food thermistor — 10 kΩ @ 77°F; 29.5 kΩ @ 36°F; 86.3 kΩ @ 0°F.

steps.title: Fresh food thermistor resistance
steps.body: Measure at control harness or sensor — 10,000 Ω ±1.8% @ 77°F.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Measure at control harness or sensor — 10,000 Ω ±1.8% @ 77°F.

steps.title: Replace FF thermistor
steps.oemOutcome: Replace fresh food thermistor or repair harness when open, short, or out of range.

steps.title: FF thermistor verified
steps.oemOutcome: Service test 4 and bench ohms verified for fresh food thermistor.
